description:
Backfilled after the fact: this work landed on 2026-09-06 without beads.

A sweep of the repo (excluding qmk_firmware) to make the agent-facing
docs match reality and to stop the build depending on tools nothing
declared. Findings that drove it:

- knight's keymap dir is a symlink to nature's, so they are one keymap
- `nix develop .#full --impure` has never worked here: shell.nix imports
  ./util/nix/sources.nix and util/ is not in the tree or its history
- jq, just, nushell and qmkfmt were all ambient dependencies of `just config`
- the Makefile hard-errored unless `qmk config user.qmk_home` was set
- README described peterhoeg.c as textually included; that is combos.inc

Children carry the individual commits.
title: Bring AGENTS.md, README and the dev shell in line with the repo
